name: Bubo Insights — Self‑Hosted Privacy‑Friendly Analytics
author: pizza2mozzarella

sections.description:
Bubo Insights is a self-hosted, privacy friendly analytics tool designed for seamless monitoring of website analytics, traffic data, and outgoing clicks.

Bubo Insights provides comprehensive website analytics data without the use of cookies, ensuring privacy friendly tracking and data ownership. Bubo Insights has a focus on in-website statistics, offering detailed stats and a simple analytics dashboard, making it an excellent analytics tool, for free.

Whether you’re looking for privacy-first solutions or simple analytics, Bubo Insights has you covered.

Top Features in a nutshell

  • Tracks Visitors, Page Visits, Referrers, and Outgoing Clicks: Offers comprehensive website analytics to monitor user behavior, ensuring you get detailed stats and insights.
  • Easy to Install: No coding or technical knowledge is required, making setup a breeze for all WordPress users looking for a simple analytics solution.
  • Embedded in Your WP Website Admin Dashboard: Access all analytics directly from your WordPress dashboard for ease of use and real-time insights into your website stats.
  • Self-Hosted Data: Ensures full data ownership with all data stored in your WordPress database, providing privacy friendly tracking and security.
  • Simple, Clean, and Responsive Analytics Dashboard: User friendly interface for easy navigation and analysis, available both on desktop and mobile devices.
  • No Cookie Banner Needed: Provides cookieless tracking for privacy friendly analytics, eliminating the need for annoying cookie banners.
  • Privacy Friendly: Does not store personal user information, ensuring compliance with privacy regulations and maintaining user trust.

Privacy Friendly, Self-Hosted, No External Accounts, Unlimited Tracking

Understanding the need for privacy in today’s digital landscape, where privacy regulations are getting stricter, Bubo Insights offers the possibility to gather insightful website analytics and traffic data without compromising user privacy, thanks to its server-side tracking methods.
Bubo Insights believes in complete data ownership. All website analytics data collected is stored in your WordPress database, ensuring privacy-friendly tracking and security. There are no limits on the number of visits or visitors that can be recorded, offering unlimited tracking capabilities. However, it’s worth noting that very high data volumes could impact performance.

Analyze Key Core Metrics with an Intuitive Dashboard

Wondering how well your website is performing? Want to see if real visitors are engaging with your content and converting? Traditional analytics tools often require complex setups, numerous customizations, and confusing metrics, along with privacy concerns over cookie banners.
With Bubo Insights, you can access all the core metrics needed to optimize your website’s performance. The intuitive dashboard provides an at-a-glance overview of your site’s performance with detailed stats on Page Visits, Visitors, Referrers, Outgoing Clicks, and more.
Bubo Insights’ Dashboard is designed to perform well both from desktop and mobile devices, ensuring that your website analytics, privacy-friendly tracking, and traffic monitoring stats are always at your fingertips, providing real-time insights into your site visitors and traffic.

Simple to use Analytics Tool

One of the standout features of our plugin is its simplicity. Setup is straightforward, even for those with limited technical expertise. You just need to press Install, and you’re ready to gain insights into what people do on your website without compromising their privacy.
Once installed, the plugin begins tracking immediately, providing you with valuable data on website analytics and traffic monitoring without the need for complex configurations. The user-friendly interface ensures that you can access and understand your website statistics effortlessly, making it a truly simple analytics solution for all WordPress users.
This makes Bubo Insights a reliable analytics tool that provides all the essential features, including website stats and outgoing clicks, without the associated privacy concerns. In fact, the plethora of metrics that most of the analytics tools offers can sometimes be overwhelming, but this plugin simplifies the process, focusing on delivering the most critical data in an accessible user friendly format. This makes it easier to make informed decisions about your website‘s content and strategy, ensuring privacy-first website analytics and traffic monitoring.

Free plugin, no subscription needed!

Moreover, this simple analytics tool delivers all these valuable insights into user behavior for free! Despite being a free analytics solution, Bubo Insights offers a robust set of functionalities that everyone should enjoy in his/her website. This makes it an ideal choice for small business owners, bloggers, and anyone looking to keep an eye on their website’s performance, traffic monitoring, and data ownership without breaking the bank.

In short, Bubo Insights is a powerful, free analytics plugin for WordPress that offers a privacy-friendly solution for tracking the traffic of your website. With its comprehensive analytics stats, simple setup, and complete data ownership, it’s the ideal solution for anyone looking to gain valuable insights into their website traffic while respecting visitor privacy.
Try it today and take the first step towards a more transparent and privacy-friendly approach to website analytics and traffic monitoring!
sections.installation:
To easily install Bubo Insights enter the WordPress dashboard and select Plugins > Add New Plugin. Search for “Bubo Insights” and install the first result you see there.
To install the zip file downloaded from this page:
1. Login to your WordPress dashboard
2. Visit the Plugins > Add New Plugin
3. Click the Upload Plugin button at the top
4. In the upload form that appears, click the Choose file button and select the bubo-insights.zip file you downloaded here
5. Click the Install Now button
6. Once the page reloads, click the blue Activate link
7. Purge your website cache.
Please make sure the Date and Time are set correctly in WordPress.
sections.faq:
Is Bubo Insights free?

Yes! Bubo Insights’ core features are free, providing comprehensive website analytics without any cost.

Does it use Google Analytics?

No, Bubo Insights is a self-hosted, privacy-friendly that does not rely on or share code with Google Analytics.

Can I use Bubo Insights and Google Analytics at the same time?

Yes, you can run both Bubo Insights and Google Analytics simultaneously without any problems, ensuring you get the best of both analytics tools.

Do I need an account?

No, Bubo Insights is a self-hosted, privacy-friendly WordPress plugin that does not require an external account.

Is technical knowledge required to operate Bubo Insights?

No, Bubo Insights is easy to install and use, even without any coding or technical knowledge. It provides comprehensive website analytics with a user-friendly interface.

Does tracking start right away?

Yes, tracking starts immediately after you install and activate Bubo Insights, providing you with real-time website analytics. If you don’t see any views right away, clear your site’s cache and then visit your site in a private browser tab to record your first view.

What metrics does it track?

Bubo Insights tracks Visitors, Visits, Referrers, and Outbound link clicks, providing comprehensive website traffic monitoring.

Is there a tracking code?

Yes, but you don’t have to add it yourself. The tracking code is automatically included on all of your site’s pages once Bubo Insights is activated, ensuring an easy and user friendly analytics tool.

Will Bubo Insights affect my site’s performance?

No, the tracking script is less than 3kb and it is embedded on all the website pages. So the difference in your site’s performance after installing Bubo Insights will be virtually zero.

Are bot visits counted?

We filter out bot visits using best practice techniques to ensure accurate visitor tracking. (e.g. bots use headless browsers and don’t run certain scripts)

Are logged-in users visits tracked?

Yes, all users’ visits are tracked. You can easily filter them out when checking the website traffic data.

Is there a limit to the number of visitors I can track?

No, there is no limit. The only limiting factor is your own WordPress database and server capacity.

Where is the data stored?

The data is stored in your own WordPress database, ensuring full data ownership.

Can I export data?

Yes, data can be exported to CSV files for easy analysis and backup.

Can I give feedback about the plugin?

Yes, please! We really value your feedback. If you have any doubts, you can submit a support request on the WordPress forums, and we will respond promptly.
